query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `leadActivities` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `leadId` int NOT NULL,
  `type` enum('email','sms','call','note') NOT NULL,
  `subject` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `body` text,
  `sentBy` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` varchar(50) DEFAULT 'sent',
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `leadActivities_leadId_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`leadId`) REFERENCES `leads` (`id`)
);
